D327~10:25 player exact 'Regroup.

What do we think team?' authorizes courteous conclusion of current audience, ordinary departure together with Mara/Cirren/Fenar and private discussion in a quiet stretch of Old Crown Ward street away from the Veldrake doorway, not an automatic appointment acceptance, trip to Desen, spell, investigation, commitment or expenditure. No V speech invented, no contested exit, no observed follower or eavesdropper; not guarantee of privacy against unknown surveillance. Halvessa remains with her prior offer; Sallow actual notification and Tavosk availability unconfirmed. Cirren independently says 'We have her own words now. All four of us heard them. That ties the purchasing instructions to her personally, but it does not tell us what she knows about Tavosk's payments. I would tell Desen before we go back. Let him decide how best to preserve our testimony and the original papers.' Mara says 'I think we should keep the appointment. She believes we're potential customers, and Sallow is the man who actually handles her arrangements. Let him explain what he can offer. We needn't buy a thing.' Fenar says 'Fenar thinks Master has enough to put the lady in trouble. But if Master wants the man who sells the warnings, Fenar would like to see him. Fenar would rather Desen know where we are going first.' These are companion opinions/recommendations, not binding legal findings or chosen future actions. They know only actual observed documents, public research and Halvessa's statement; no knowledge of hidden patron proposal, actual Tavosk attendance or other crimes. V has not reported statement, agreed a time, returned, hired anyone or agreed illicit commerce. All resource/custody counters unchanged. Await V decision.
